study: Gamma B1 last-layer readout adapter, first MiniCPM4 0.5B transfer
status: prospective lock; independent model and confirmation tables; no outcome observed when locked

compatibility.before_holdout: Check markers, valid decoded support codes, whole-table length, complete answers and fresh-vs-snapshot greedy token identity. Report incompatibility if a parity error remains; never tune gain, ridge, thresholds, codes or model from this smoke.

confirm.batching: identical single seeded design, disjoint ranges of four whole tables per process; preserve table identifiers and one receipt per range, restart failed ranges without replacing any recorded outcome

method.candidate: ra_bare; existing last-layer readout, gain 1.0, relative ridge 0.15; isolated and whole-table support contexts; zero support-table tokens in the query
method.decoding: unconstrained greedy, existing canonicalization and up to 8 generated tokens for both generative arms; include word and multi-part codes even if their actual token lengths differ by tokenizer. Report both strata. A wrong or truncated code remains counted. No first-token restriction or support-label correction.

adjudication.primary: paired table accuracy ra_bare minus kv_ctx; one-sided exact sign-flip for non-inferiority at minus 5 points, alpha .05; report 90% paired-table bootstrap interval. Superiority only if one-sided test at zero also passes. Restrict generalization to these groups unless the group-aware lower bound clears the margin.
adjudication.classifier: also compare ra_bare versus probe_bare. An equivalence claim needs the full 90% interval inside +/-5 points. If the plain classifier is at least as accurate, report its practical result.
adjudication.controls: every question has fresh full-table vs warm KV parity on the entire generated token-ID sequence; most-frequent code must score 25%; 96 tables and 1536 unique complete questions required. Any failed validity control is reported, with no confirmed win.
adjudication.state: compare logical adapter bytes with used KV bytes; also report allocated snapshot memory. 10x state reduction and ZST (zero support-table tokens) are separate from accuracy.
adjudication.time: include common preparation, support capture, fit and device materialization for candidate, plus GPU-completed warm-KV build, restore and per-question time. Record full-table plain and plain readout too. Latencies descriptive, fixed arm ordering.
adjudication.abstention: covered-question classification only. No new abstention or document-memory claim.
adjudication.failure: development compatibility failures do not spend the holdout. Any held-out failure remains on record and cannot be repaired by reselecting examples or changing the locked algorithm.
